narr: A wave of low pressure tracked along a stalled front across portions of the southern Coastal Plain. The combination of day time heating and the aforementioned frontal forcing and moisture pooling along the front lead to the development of heavy rain and isolated flash flooding in Sampson County.
ev: Heavy rain and flash flooding wash out a portion of a road in Autryville.
lsr: HEAVY RAIN AND FLASH FLOODING WASHED OUT PORTION OF MAXWELL ROAD IN AUTRYVILLE, NC.
